title: extract-zip unvalidated symlink path traversal
reason: extract-zip has no patched release: 2.0.1 is the latest and the advisory covers <=2.0.1. The upstream fix is @electron/packager 20, which replaced extract-zip with @electron-internal/extract-zip, and stable Electron Forge 7.11.2 requires @electron/packager ^18.3.5.
notExploitableHere: The dependency is reached through Electron Packager during trusted application builds and is not exposed to user-supplied archives at runtime.
resolvesWhen: Remove this entry once Electron Forge 8 is released as stable, which requires @electron/packager ^20, and packaging plus the Electron end-to-end run pass on it. Forcing @electron/packager 20 under Forge 7 clears the advisory but breaks packaging, because Forge 7 passes callback-style afterFinalizePackageTargets hooks that packager 20 expects to return promises. Tracked in issue #103.
